title: Unbounded strong-product ratios for the Grundy domination number — submission package
description:
Unbounded strong-product ratios for the Grundy domination number. Hexagon/Overleaf and Journal of Combinatorial Theory, Series B submission preparation, version 1.3.0. The reviewed folder Paper_1 package contains the article PDF, a minimal compilable TeX ZIP, AI provenance, Hexagon fields, journal details, an unsent cover letter with editable source, and an author-prepared AI disclosure. All PDFs have no row or margin line numbers. No journal submission or acceptance is claimed.

The paper proves that strong-product ratios for the Grundy domination number are unbounded, using an explicit two-field incidence construction. It also determines an all-parameter graph family and supplies a 114-vertex counterexample to multiplicativity. The general proofs are elementary and independent of finite computation.

Verification scope: The Lean certificate verifies the original finite N=21 counterexample. The general unbounded-ratio theorem and all-parameter formula are written proofs, not a general Lean formalisation.

Original preprint: https://hexagonmath.org/2610.00494v1. Earlier manuscript/source DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.23607502. Original attribution and component licences are preserved. Human-understanding and mixed-text declarations record the submitting author's explicit statement on 25 October 2026. The standalone AI declaration is author-prepared, not an official signed publisher form.
